title: 5 · Observe the coding work and connect it to runs
summary: Task/requirement version → agent/session → commands/diff → verification/judgments → commit/result.
body:
Task/requirement version → agent/session → commands/diff → verification/judgments → commit/result.

An application run records the code version, connecting this development timeline to the separate application timeline.

Live status: task/model, outstanding work, elapsed/deadline, attempts, evidence and last saved result.

Afterwards: exact changed files, why, results, unresolved issues and next action.

Use local journals as durable records. Automatic tool capture needs a host-specific adapter; shared semantic records remain portable.

Codex hook configuration exists but live delivery was not established. Other tools do not inherit Codex hooks.

No hidden reasoning capture. Save decisions explicitly; event hooks cannot infer their meaning.
